name: Mistral Small 4 119B A6B
definition: Mistral Small 4 119B A6B is an open-weight Mistral Small 4 model by Mistral AI focused on general instruction, reasoning, coding, agents, function calling and vision.

license.name: Apache 2.0
license.commercial_use: Review exact official terms before production.

hardware.summary: Datacenter / multi-GPU class at full precision; NVIDIA publishes an NVFP4 checkpoint for lower-memory serving.

deployment.summary: Mistral documents vLLM as a recommended serving path; Transformers support is also available.
deployment.eu_eea_self_hosting: Technically possible when the complete inference stack is operated on EU/EEA infrastructure.
deployment.data_residency: Provider origin does not determine data residency.
